ui.plugins.title: Installed plugins
ui.plugins.desc: Plugins extend the drive: themes apply instantly, and file-type plugins can open formats the built-in previewer does not support.
ui.plugins.enable_hint: Off by default. Plugins are third-party content; once enabled you can install and manage them. Disabling stops them from taking effect (files are kept).
ui.plugins.installed_toast: Plugin installed (disabled by default — enable it manually)
ui.plugins.delete_title: Remove “{name}”? Its files will be deleted.
ui.plugins.disabled_hint: Plugins are disabled. Turn on the switch above to install plugins.
ui.plugins.runtime_later: The runtime for this plugin kind lands in a later version: you can install and toggle it, but it has no effect yet.
ui.plugins.safety_note: Plugins are provided by third parties and get no file permissions except theme colors. Only enable sources you trust.
